\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-91},
  title = {A green CI run on \texorpdfstring{\texttt{main}}{main} publishes the API image to GHCR},
  note = {\textbf{Revised on 2026-10-30}: the packages stay private (EDN-94); since 2026-11-04 CD also pushes a stack image (\#279).},
  date = {2026-10-22},
  milestone = {M5: Model Packaging},
  topic = {CI/CD, Containerization, Security},
  participants = {@lukas2510 decided (\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/197}{issue \#197})},
  decision = {A workflow of its own, \texttt{cd.\allowbreak{}yml}, runs after CI passed on a push to \texttt{main} that changes more than documentation.
It pulls the model with a DagsHub token from the GitHub Environment \texttt{dagshub}, which only \texttt{main} may use, tests the image as a Compose stack, and pushes it, with a stack image of the commit's stack files, to private GHCR.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item A read-only DagsHub account for CI: one more account, against a threat a three-person team with branch protection does not face.
\item A public package: the organisation's settings do not allow one.
\item A job in \texttt{ci.\allowbreak{}yml}: the secret would sit in the workflow pull requests run.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} DagsHub tokens have no read-only scope, so the protection is where the token can be used: one step of one job, after a push to \texttt{main}, never on a pull request (NFR-15).
The API key reaches the container at run time and the stack files travel in an image of their own, so the API image holds only code and the model the model card describes.
Built locally, the 704 MB image (NFR-04: 1 GB) passed the 27 integration tests.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI laid out the three questions with their options in the issue and recommended the chosen ones; @lukas2510 decided all three as recommended.
AI then wrote the workflow and checked the build, the size gate, and the integration suite locally with the real model.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-10-22 planning Milestone 5.
Question from issue \#197 (paraphrased): ``How does CI get the model, is the GHCR package public, and what triggers the build?''.
Lukas answered: ``its own workflow that runs only after CI passed on that commit, so a red \texttt{main} never publishes an image.'' (the trigger); for the package ``A, because the image holds no secret and no personal data (the API key is passed at run time).'' (later changed to private)},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/197}{Issue \#197}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/207}{PR \#207}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/.github/workflows/cd.yml}{\texttt{cd.\allowbreak{}yml}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/deployment.md\#continuous-delivery}{deployment docs}, EDN-08.},
